verdict.rationale: Autumn documents webhooks that fire when a customer's plans change (new subscriptions, upgrades, downgrades) and positions them for syncing external systems. That covers only the basic delivery part of the story. The MCP 'log tools' and 'request-log investigations' concern API request logs, not webhook delivery logs, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: webhook signature verification, automatic retry behavior, webhook event/delivery logs, replay of past deliveries, independent corroboration.
